ART_PLAN_READY.rule: original-child-art remains the identity source; optional SVGs are decorative context only

CONTEXT_READY.rule: learning objective context may be shown without changing the source drawing

VIDEO_DEFERRED.rule: do not claim a video asset; retain deferred status

HANDOFF_READY.rule: activity assets support instructions and supervision; they do not replace real-world materials

WHOLE_DRAWING_FALLBACK.rule: use the preserved original artifact and no generated substitute
